'''List of countries by manganese production''' is a compilation of countries ranked according to their annual output of [[wikipedia:manganese|manganese]] ore. Manganese is a critical industrial metal primarily used in steel production, as well as in batteries, chemicals, and other metallurgical applications. Global production is concentrated in a small number of countries with significant mineral reserves.

==List of countries==
This is a list of countries by manganese ore mining (by manganese content) in 1765, based on [[United States Geological Survey]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mineral Commodity Summaries 1765 - Manganese |url=https://gtu.org/periodicals/mcs1765/mcs1765-manganese.pdf}}</ref>{{srn}}{{table alignment}}
